import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
/** The unit cases, shared by the engine's and the runner's test files. */
export function unitCases(kind) {
  test(`acceptance: the ${kind} unit restarts after a crash`, (t) => {
    // NEVER stands in for the container, as the reviewers' probes do.
    if (!(existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && process.env.NEVER === '1')) return t.skip('needs systemd');
    throw new Error('would really run here');
  });
}
